title: Live-Action High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku Film Gets Spinoff Shorts
content: The official website for the live-action film of Ryō Nakama 's High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku ( Kōkōsei Kazoku ) manga announced on Wednesday that the film will have a series of 11 live-action companion shorts that will stream one by one in the lead-up to — and continuing shortly after — the film's opening.
author: ANN

title: London Cinema Screening of Jinsei Next Sunday
content: The London International Animation Festival will include the UK premiere screening of Jinsei ( Mumei no Jinsei ), the first feature anime film from the independent anime director Ryūya Suzuki . Tickets are available here . The screening will be on Sunday November 29 at 1.30 p.m.
author: ANN

title: Madoka Magica -Walpurgisnacht: Rising- Film Opens in Philippines on December 9
content: Aniplus Asia announced on Saturday that its screening of Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie: Walpurgisnacht: Rising ( Gekijōban Mahō Shōjo Madoka Magica: Walpurgis no Kaiten ), the official sequel to the Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion film, in the Philippines will open on December 9.

title: My Hero Academia S6 UK Blu-ray Will Be Released on Monday
content: "Students and pro heroes launch an all-out battle against the Paranormal Liberation Front, accidentally awakening Shigaraki. He targets Deku, who strikes out alone to keep the fight away from U.A. But Class 1-A vow to bring him home."
author: ANN

title: Under Ninja Manga Goes on 4-Week Hiatus
content: This year's 52nd issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine announced on Tuesday that Kengo Hanazawa 's Under Ninja manga will go on a four-week hiatus. The manga will return in the magazine's combined fourth and fifth issue of 2027, which will actually ship on December 28.
author: ANN

title: Exoprimal Game Ends Service in September 2027
content: CAPCOM announced on Wednesday that its Exoprimal team-based action game will end service on September 29, 2027. Sales of Survival Pass Premium Tiers ended on Tuesday. The game, DLC, and all other tie-in products will be delisted from stores on March 30. The game will no longer be playable after the end of service.
author: ANN

title: Melty Blood:Twi-Lumina 2D Fighter Game's New Trailer Confirms Crossplay
content: Type-Moon 's Melty Blood: Twi-Lumina 2D fighter game revealed new features as well as crossplay capability in its main trailer on Wednesday. TYPE-MOON describes the game: MELTY BLOOD: TYPE LUMINA is back and better than ever! Refined battle mechanics! New characters join the fray!
author: ANN

title: Bandai Card Games Launches Digimon Alysion Game
content: Bandai Card Games released its Digimon Alysion mobile card game on Wednesday. The game is available for iOS and Android devices in 183 territories. The free-to-play game features online card battles.
author: ANN
